title: Racks and shelves
purpose: Find racks, towers, shelves and canisters across all storage units. Each one holds either other shelves or racks, or boxes.
summary: Find racks, towers, shelves and canisters across all storage units. Each holds either other racks or shelves, or boxes.

tasks.title: Find a rack or shelf
steps: Type part of the code or name in [[Search]], or choose the [[Storage unit]], then select [[Apply]].
Select the number in the [[Free]] column to see available positions in that rack or shelf.

tasks.title: Add a rack or shelf
steps: Admin and manager: select [[New rack or shelf]], or use Add rack or shelf on the unit's page.

good_to_know: Only active racks and shelves are listed until you change [[Status]].
Counts include everything inside the node.
Location is the path of codes from the top of the unit.

sections.title: Search, filters and sorting
paragraphs: Search matches part of the code or name, ignoring capitals.
Without a status filter only active racks and shelves are listed.
Click a sortable column heading to sort by it; click again to reverse. Ties keep a stable order. Choose 25, 50 or 100 rows per page; the default is 25.

items.label: Free positions
items.description: Any, Has free positions, or No free positions, counting everything inside it.

items.label: Site, Room
items.description: Limit by where the unit stands.

items.label: Status
items.description: Active (the default), Retired, or Active and retired.

items.label: Code
items.description: Immutable code; opens the page. Always shown.

items.label: Location
items.description: Path of codes from the top of the unit to this node. Sortable.

items.label: Slot
items.description: Its numbered place in the unit or in its parent.

items.label: Holds
items.description: Node slots or box slots it offers.

items.label: Positions, Blocked, Occupied, Free
items.description: Counts cover installed positions in the rack or shelf and its child locations. Only active storage contributes to capacity. Free is the total minus blocked and occupied positions. Select a positive Free count to list those positions. Zero has no link. Opening the list does not reserve a position. Occupied and Free are sortable.

items.label: Status
items.description: Active, or Retired once the record has been retired.

items.label: Export CSV
items.description: Downloads the rows that match the current search, filters and sort as a UTF-8 CSV file. Any role that can read this list can download it. The download uses the rows that match when the export runs. If more than 10,000 rows match, narrow the filters and export again. Cells that a spreadsheet could read as a formula are prefixed with an apostrophe, and numbers are exact decimals. The audit trail records who exported the selection and the number of data rows in the CSV. An over-limit request produces no download or export event.

items.label: New rack or shelf
items.description: Opens the create form. Shown only to the admin and manager roles.

items.label: No records yet
items.description: Shown when nothing has been defined. Users who may create records see the create button in the message.

items.label: Nothing matches these filters
items.description: The search or filters exclude every row. Change or clear them.

items.label: These filters cannot be applied
items.description: A filter value was not valid. The list shows no rows rather than all rows; correct the highlighted filter.
